environment.description: ECS Fargate task in 'application' namespace on the same EKS cluster. Istio sidecar is injected with STRICT mTLS (namespace-level PeerAuthentication). An AuthorizationPolicy named 'config-receiver-policy' is applied to workloads with label app=config-receiver in the 'application' namespace. The policy specifies: action ALLOW, source principals ['cluster.local/ns/platform-system/sa/config-sync-sa'], and the rule matches only requests to paths ['/internal/config/update'] with methods ['POST']. A second AuthorizationPolicy named 'deny-all-default' with action DENY is applied as a catch-all for the namespace with no rules (implicit deny-all for unmatched requests). The Envoy sidecar intercepts all inbound traffic on port 8080 before it reaches the application container. Note: the STRICT PeerAuthentication means plaintext connections are rejected at the proxy level, and the AuthorizationPolicy source principal check validates the SPIFFE identity from the mTLS handshake, not an application-layer header.
